notes: ⬆ The version button now fits every window: on narrower screens it shows just its icon (an update still says Update) instead of pushing the top bar off the screen
GlowRoom shows the version / Update button too, and always loads the newest Glow (it could keep an old copy with the update button hidden in a menu)
↩ Glow reopens where you left off: the app you were in, the chat you had open and the message you hadn't sent yet (turn it off in the Glow apps menu)
⬆ Your version is always shown at the top of every Glow app; when a new version is ready it turns into an orange Update button
Updates install by themselves when Glow opens or when you switch away, never in the middle of a reply; then "Glow updated" shows What's new
No more "free Puter AI allowance is used up" warnings in chats: your backup model answers straight away, also when the browser storage is full or two chats ask at once
🎨 Pictures and 🎬 videos say plainly when the monthly allowance is used up
🌸 Connecting a Pollinations wallet now shows Glow by name on the approval screen and always brings you back to GlowChat, also when it was opened as …/index.html
🔋 Low power mode: one tap next to the token counter for shorter answers and less chat history sent, so every reply uses fewer tokens
